app.title: Brainy Clan
app.tagline: Learn and play together as a family.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do that.

errors.categoryNotAllowed: This category isn't available for you.

update.title: Time for an update
update.body: A new version of Brainy Clan is available. Update the app to keep playing.

home.noScoresBody: Play a round to get the family started!
home.noGoalBody: Pick a reward — pizza night, a movie, a day out — and let the family play for it.

appearance.lookOnly: The theme only changes how the app looks — never the content or the rules.

ad.notCompleted: Watch the video to the end to get your second chance.

resume.title: Continue your game

resume.outOfLives: Out of lives, a second chance is waiting

dev.themesSubtitle: Developer tool: every base component in every theme.

welcome.subtitle: Learn, play and reach goals together — the whole family.
welcome.joinHint: Kids and family members: ask the parent who set up Brainy Clan for your code.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email and password.
login.noAccount: New here? Create a parent account

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: You'll set up your family right after.
register.birthHint: Parent accounts are for adults. We only use this to set up the right experience.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

join.title: Join your family
join.subtitle: Type the 8-character code your parent gave you.
join.withLoginHint: Optional for adult family members, so you can sign in on other devices.

createFamily.title: Create your family
createFamily.subtitle: Hi {{name}}! Name your family to get started.
createFamily.name: Family name
createFamily.timezoneHint: Daily goals end at midnight in this time zone.

family.noInvitesBody: Invite your family so you can play together.
family.limitBody: Your plan allows {{max}} members, including pending invites. Upgrade to the Family plan to add more.
family.adminOnlyHint: Only family admins can invite and edit members.
family.goalsHint: See what the family is playing for
family.goalsHintAdmin: Set targets and rewards for the family

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.subtitle: Kids just need a nickname — no email, no real name.
invite.nicknameHint: Shown to the family. Avoid full names for kids.
invite.birthHint: Used to pick age-appropriate content. Only admins can see it.
invite.howTo: On their device: open Brainy Clan, tap “Join with invite code” and type this code.
invite.shareMessage: Join our family on Brainy Clan! Open the app, tap “Join with invite code” and enter {{code}} (for {{name}}).

member.difficultyHint: Auto uses the range suggested for their age. Set a level to make questions easier or harder.
member.removeHint: They will lose access on all their devices. Their points stay in the history.

profile.appearanceNeedsFamily: Appearance settings are available once you're in a family.

goals.title: Family goals
goals.subtitle: Play together toward a reward.
goals.emptyAdmin: Create a goal with a reward to motivate the family.
goals.emptyMember: Ask a family admin to set a goal with a reward.
goals.limitBody_one: Your plan allows {{count}} active goal. Pause one, or upgrade to the Family plan for more.
goals.limitBody_other: Your plan allows {{count}} active goals. Pause one, or upgrade to the Family plan for more.

modeHelp.cooperation: Everyone's points add up. Reach the target together and the whole family wins the reward.
modeHelp.competition: Everyone plays for themselves. Whoever scores the most points by the end wins the reward.

periodHelp.daily: A fresh start every day at midnight.
periodHelp.monthly: Runs for the whole calendar month.

goals.noPointsYet: No points yet in this period. Be the first!
goals.pausedHint: This goal is paused. Points are not counted until it is resumed.
goals.deleteHint: Changes start with the next period. Pausing keeps the goal listed; deleting removes it for everyone.

wizard.nameHelp: Give it a name the family will love.
wizard.categoriesHelp: Points from these categories count. Picking a category includes all its topics.
wizard.targetHelpTeam: How many points should the family collect together each period?
wizard.targetHelpEach: How many points should each player aim for each period?
wizard.ownTargetHint: Smaller targets keep it fair for younger players.
wizard.rewardHelp: What does the family get? A good reward is the best motivation.
wizard.noReward: No reward set — you can still play for bragging rights.

gone.title: This goal was deleted
gone.body: An admin removed it. Its points still count in your stats.

codeSignIn.title: Sign in with a code
codeSignIn.subtitle: Already in a family? Ask your parent for a sign-in code on their phone.
codeSignIn.codeHint: 8 letters and numbers. Spaces and dashes don't matter.
codeSignIn.help: Your parent opens Brainy Clan → Family → your name → “Sign in on another device”. The code works for 15 minutes.
codeSignIn.newHere: First time? Use your invite code instead

signInCode.title: Sign in on another device
signInCode.intro: Make a one-time code so {{name}} can sign in on a new phone or tablet — no email or password needed.
signInCode.expired: This code has expired. Make a new one.
signInCode.step1: On the other device, open Brainy Clan.
signInCode.step3: Type the 8 letters and numbers. Done!
signInCode.newCodeHint: A new code makes the old one stop working.
signInCode.shareMessage: Sign in to Brainy Clan as {{name}}: open the app, tap “I have a sign-in code” and enter {{code}}. It works for 15 minutes.

memberLogin.title: Sign-in & devices
memberLogin.signInOnDeviceHint: Get a code for a new phone or tablet.
memberLogin.emailHint: Lets {{name}} sign in with email and a password. They choose the password on their own device (Profile → Set password).
memberLogin.emailNone: No email login — {{name}} signs in with a code.
memberLogin.removeEmailHint: Removing it also deletes the password. {{name}} can still sign in with a code.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.signedOutHint: Signing a device out ends the session there. It can sign in again with a code or password.

password.title: Password
password.setHint: Choose a password to sign in with {{email}} on other devices.

sudoku.title: Sudoku {{size}}×{{size}}
sudoku.rules: Fill every row, column and box with the numbers 1 to {{size}}, each once.
sudoku.clash: Some numbers appear twice in a row, column or box.
sudoku.ready: All cells are filled. Check your grid!
sudoku.fillAll: Tap a cell, then a number. Fill every cell to check.
sudoku.solutionHint: Here is the solution. Green cells are where your grid was different.
sudoku.mineHint: This is the grid you sent.

math.timeUp: Time's up, but you can still answer

word.searchHelp: Drag across a word, or tap its first and last letter. Words can go in any direction.
word.cellHint: Choose the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
word.firstChosen: {{letter}} chosen as the first letter. Now choose the last letter.
word.notAWord: That's not one of the words. Try again!
word.giveUpHint: Giving up counts as a mistake.
word.missedHint: Dashed red bands show the words you didn't find.

social.failed: {{provider}} sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
social.birthTitle: Tell us your birth year and month
social.birthBody: One last step to create your account with {{provider}}. Accounts with Apple, Google or Facebook are for adults; we only use this to set up the right experience.
social.devFake: Dev: buttons use a fake {{provider}} token (EXPO_PUBLIC_SOCIAL_FAKE).

signInMethods.title: Sign-in methods
signInMethods.hint: Connect Apple, Google or Facebook to sign in with one tap on any device.
signInMethods.unavailable: Not available in this version of the app

errors.network: Couldn't reach the store. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notAllowed: Purchases aren't allowed on this device (check Screen Time or Google Play restrictions).
errors.pending: Your payment is pending. The Family plan starts as soon as the store confirms it.
errors.alreadyOwned: This store account already has a Brainy Clan subscription, possibly for another family. Try “Restore purchases”, or use the account that bought it.
errors.unavailable: The Family plan isn't available right now. Please try again later.
errors.store: The store had a problem. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong with the purchase. Please try again.

paywall.title: Family plan
paywall.subtitle: One subscription for the whole family
paywall.wholeFamily: Everyone in your family gets the Family plan, children included. Cancel any time in the App Store or Google Play.
paywall.activating: Activating the Family plan for your family…
paywall.nothingToRestore: No active Family plan was found for this store account.
paywall.noPackages: No plans are available yet. Please try again later.
paywall.alreadyFamily: Your family already has the Family plan.
paywall.notAllowed: Only a family admin can manage the plan.
paywall.notInBuild: Purchases are only available in the Brainy Clan app for iPhone and Android.
paywall.welcomeBody: Everyone in your family now has the Family plan.
paywall.delayedBody: Your purchase went through. It can take a few minutes until the Family plan shows in the app — no need to buy again.
paywall.legal: Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your store account settings.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose what Brainy Clan tells you about

typeHints.goal_reached: When the family reaches a goal or someone wins a race
typeHints.family_activity: When someone in the family finishes a session
typeHints.daily_reminder: If you haven't played yet today

notifications.quietHint: No notifications during quiet hours; they wait until quiet hours end.
notifications.timezoneHint: Times use your family's time zone.
notifications.unavailableBody: Notification settings will appear here soon.
notifications.pushBody: Turn them on to hear about goals, results and your daily reminder.
notifications.pushBlockedBody: Notifications are blocked for Brainy Clan. You can allow them in your phone's settings.
notifications.quietOff: No quiet hours: notifications can arrive at any time.

deletion.accountSubtitle: Permanently delete your Brainy Clan account.
deletion.pointErased: Your name, email, password, birth date and avatar are erased.
deletion.pointSignOut: You're signed out on every device right away.
deletion.pointSocial: Connected Apple, Google and Facebook accounts are disconnected.
deletion.pointHistory: Points history stays for the family's totals, but anonymised: it shows "Deleted player" instead of a name.
deletion.pointFamilyToo: You're the only member of your family, so the family is deleted too.
deletion.cancelAppStore: Your family plan is billed through the App Store. Cancel it in your Apple ID subscriptions first — deleting your account doesn't stop billing.
deletion.cancelPlayStore: Your family plan is billed through Google Play. Cancel it in Google Play → Subscriptions first — deleting your account doesn't stop billing.
deletion.cancelStoreGeneric: Your family has an active subscription. Cancel it where you bought it (App Store / Google Play) first — deleting your account doesn't stop billing.
deletion.ownerTitle: You own a family with other members
deletion.ownerBody: The owner can't leave the family behind. Delete the family first (you can delete your account in the same step).
deletion.notPossible: Your account can't be deleted right now.
deletion.ownerOnly: Only the family owner can delete the family.
deletion.familyPointGone: The family, its goals and invites are deleted.
deletion.familyPointErased_one: {{count}} member without their own login (email, Google, Apple or Facebook — like a child) is erased: their account can't exist outside the family.
deletion.familyPointErased_other: {{count}} members without their own login (email, Google, Apple or Facebook — like children) are erased: their accounts can't exist outside the family.
deletion.familyPointKept_one: {{count}} other member with their own login keeps their account, without a family.
deletion.familyPointKept_other: {{count}} other members with their own login keep their accounts, without a family.
deletion.alsoMyAccountHint: Otherwise you keep your account and can create or join a new family.
deletion.typeFamilyName: Type the family name "{{name}}" to confirm
deletion.doneBody: Thanks for playing with Brainy Clan. You're signed out on every device.
deletion.managedTitle: Your family admin can do this
deletion.managedBody: Accounts of children and teens are managed by the family. Ask a family admin to remove you from the family — that deletes your account.

legal.opensBrowser: Opens the page in a browser
legal.acceptTerms: I agree to the Terms of use and the Privacy policy
legal.parentalConsent: If this is a child: I'm their parent or guardian (or have their permission) and agree to the Privacy policy for their data
legal.parentalConsentHint: Required to invite children. Not needed for teens and adults.
legal.updateSubtitle: Please review them to keep using Brainy Clan
legal.updateBody: Our Terms of use and Privacy policy have changed. Tap each one to read it, then accept to continue.
legal.declineHint: If you don't agree, you can sign out.
legal.exportHint: A copy of your data as a JSON file (once per hour).
legal.exportFailed: We couldn't save the file. Please try again.
legal.exportRateLimited: You can download your data once per hour. Please try again later.
legal.exportUnavailable: Downloading your data isn't available yet.
legal.exportNotAllowed: Your family admin manages your data. Ask them for a copy.
legal.unchanged: No changes since you last accepted it
legal.parentalConsentRequired: I'm their parent or guardian (or have their permission) and agree to the Privacy policy for their data
legal.adPrivacyChoicesHint: Change what you allow for the short videos
legal.adPrivacyChoicesFailed: The privacy choices couldn't be opened. Please try again.

lockout.title: Too many attempts
lockout.loginHint: For your safety, signing in with a password is paused for a while. You can still reset your password, use a sign-in code from a family admin, or sign in with Apple, Google or Facebook if your account uses one.
lockout.codeHint: For your safety, codes can't be entered from this device for a while. Wait for the timer, then type the code again. Adults can sign in with their email instead.
lockout.joinHint: For your safety, codes can't be entered from this device for a while. Wait for the timer, then type the code again.
lockout.forgotHint: Wait for the timer, then try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you sign in with. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses this email, we sent a link to reset the password. It works for 60 minutes.
forgot.sentSpam: Nothing there? Check your spam folder, or try again in a few minutes. Open the link on any device to choose a new password, then sign in here.
